name: Theme Toggle
description: A sun–moon theme button whose glyphs cross-rotate, plus a Light / System / Dark switch; the new theme wipes across the page in a circle from the control.

props.name: mode
props.description: The chosen mode; System follows prefers-color-scheme live. Uncontrolled when omitted (starts dark).

props.name: onModeChange
props.description: Called with the new mode, inside the view transition so the wipe captures your re-render.

props.name: variant
props.description: A single sun/moon button, or a three-way Light / System / Dark radio group.

props.name: reveal
props.description: Wipe the new theme across the page in a circle from the control. Falls back to an instant switch without View Transitions.

props.name: surface
props.description: Colours the control's own chrome for the surface it sits on. Defaults to the resolved theme.

props.name: labels
props.description: Segmented only: show words beside the glyphs. Icon-only segments keep accessible names and tooltips.

props.name: set
props.description: Stage only, not a ThemeToggle prop. Jumps the preview to a mode; used by the Customize panel.
